name: ArtworkDesk for WooCommerce
author: zieasoft

sections.description:
ArtworkDesk is order tracking for print-on-demand and custom merchandise businesses: screen printers, embroiderers, sign makers, engravers and 3D printing shops. Each order moves from the customer’s design, to a mockup they approve online, through your production stages to dispatch.

This plugin links your WooCommerce shop to your ArtworkDesk account in a few clicks:

  • Click Connect to ArtworkDesk under WooCommerce > ArtworkDesk.
  • Choose your ArtworkDesk business (or start a free trial).
  • Approve ArtworkDesk on WooCommerce’s own approval page.

From then on, every paid order arrives in ArtworkDesk by itself:

  • the customer is found or added, with their delivery address;
  • products are matched by SKU, then by name;
  • size and colour options are grouped into one line with a size breakdown;
  • personalisation and design links from the order are kept for the print job;
  • the customer can be asked for their design straight away;
  • orders are never added twice.

The plugin page shows whether the link is working: ArtworkDesk’s API key, when it was last used, and each order webhook with any failed deliveries. Disconnect removes ArtworkDesk’s key and webhooks from your shop.

You need an ArtworkDesk account (14 days free, no card needed). ArtworkDesk is a paid service from Zieasoft Limited; see pricing.

The plugin doesn’t change your checkout, products or orders, and adds nothing to your shop’s front end.

External services

This plugin connects your shop to ArtworkDesk (https://artworkdesk.com), a hosted service run by Zieasoft Limited, so that your orders can be managed there.

  • When you click Connect, your browser goes to ArtworkDesk (https://app.artworkdesk.com/connect/woocommerce/start) with your shop’s address, so ArtworkDesk knows which shop to connect. You then sign in to ArtworkDesk and approve access on WooCommerce’s standard approval page (/wc-auth/v1/authorize on your own site).
  • After you approve, WooCommerce creates a REST API key for ArtworkDesk and sends it to ArtworkDesk. ArtworkDesk uses the key to add order webhooks to your shop and to read new orders.
  • When an order is placed or updated, WooCommerce sends it to ArtworkDesk through those webhooks: the order number, items (name, SKU, quantity, options and personalisation), the customer’s name, email, phone, billing and delivery addresses, and order notes.

Nothing is sent until you connect, and nothing is sent after you disconnect or uninstall the plugin (both remove ArtworkDesk’s key and webhooks).

If you enter a different ArtworkDesk address under Advanced (or a developer sets the artworkdesk_wc_app_url filter), Connect, Open ArtworkDesk and the data above go to that address instead, which is run by whoever gave it to you.

ArtworkDesk terms of service and privacy policy.
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate the plugin (WooCommerce must be active).
  2. Go to WooCommerce > ArtworkDesk and click Connect to ArtworkDesk.
  3. Choose your business in ArtworkDesk, then click Approve on the WooCommerce page.

Your shop needs an https address and permalinks set to anything but Plain (Settings > Permalinks). The plugin page checks both for you.
sections.faq:
Do I need this plugin to use ArtworkDesk with WooCommerce?

No. You can also connect from ArtworkDesk (Settings > Website orders > Connect WooCommerce) by typing your shop’s address. The plugin lets you start from WordPress instead and shows the connection here.

Which orders are sent?

Orders are sent as they are placed and updated, and ArtworkDesk adds the paid ones (status Processing or Completed). Orders placed before you connected are not added; import them in ArtworkDesk from a CSV if you need them.

What if my site was offline when an order came in?

WooCommerce retries webhook deliveries, and ArtworkDesk also checks the shop for new orders regularly, so none are missed. Orders are never added twice.

Can I use a different ArtworkDesk address?

Yes. If your print service gave you a different address to sign in at, enter it under Advanced on the plugin page.

Does it work with High-Performance Order Storage and the checkout block?

Yes. The plugin reads and changes no orders itself, so it works with every order storage and checkout.

How do I disconnect?

Click Disconnect under WooCommerce > ArtworkDesk. That removes ArtworkDesk’s API key and webhooks. Deleting the plugin does the same. Remove the shop in ArtworkDesk too, under Settings > Website orders.
